description.value: Tim Hortons on Robson Street is a Canadian coffee chain staple situated in Vancouver's West End, close to the Stanley Park seawall cycling routes. It serves fresh-brewed coffee made with 100% Arabica beans, a range of baked goods including Timbits and donuts, and light meals such as breakfast wraps and soups. Indoor seating and WiFi access make it a practical urban rest stop for cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver.
